included: paper-numbered table fragments and CSV cells
saved answer outputs, exact Web prompts, refusal flags and usage where present

reproducibility_boundary: Supports inspection and offline checks of released records. This is not a complete end-to-end experiment reproduction package. Prompts and methodological details may permit an independent reimplementation.
prompt_boundary: All saved requests in selected canonical Web run directories are released. Historical reasoning streams do not preserve every instantiated request; source templates are released for those arms. Missing prompt records are not reconstructed or presented as originals.
cost_boundary: Logical references must not be added to physical provider attempts. Shared cached responses, unknown attempts, missing usage and historical versus current cohorts remain distinct.
